steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: AO4 (5-10%): covers spelling, punctuation, and structure. A well-organised essay scores higher. | Top Tip: Always spend 5 minutes planning before writing. A student with a strong plan and 3 well-structured paragraphs will outperform a student with 5 rambling paragraphs every time. Examiners reward coherent argument over quantity — structure is your roadmap to every mark.
